inv.location: Calle del General Díaz Porlier, Lista, Barrio de Salamanca, Madrid
inv.desc_es:
Se traspasa majestuoso local de 400m2 todos en una planta con 14 metros lineas de fachada, el local cuenta con tres ventanales a la calle mas la puerta de entrada, posee una gran altura y excelentes calidades tanto en mobiliario, cocina e iluminación, Se distribuye en barra para coctelería a la derecha del local a la izquierda un gran salon con tres ventanales cocina vista
( parrilla, fuegos, woks), la cocina tiene entrada con pase al salón y el office con una entrada aparte. Continuando se encuentran los baños y salón principal y al fondo un reservado con su propio baño. Bodega, almacenes y cámaras. El local se entrega llave en mano.
Traspaso: 300.000€ + 5% de comisión de agencia Renta: 6900€ + 1 mes de comisión

inv.desc_en:
Majestic 400m2 premises for lease transfer, all on one floor with 14 linear meters of facade. The premises feature three large street-facing windows plus the entrance door, high ceilings, and excellent quality in furniture, kitchen, and lighting. It is laid out with a cocktail bar to the right, and to the left, a large dining room with three windows and an open kitchen (grill, burners, woks). The kitchen has an entrance with a service pass to the dining room, and the scullery has a separate entrance. Continuing through, there are restrooms, the main dining room, and a private room at the back with its own restroom. Wine cellar, storage rooms, and walk-in coolers. The premises are delivered turnkey.
Transfer fee: €300,000 + 5% agency commission. Rent: €6,900 + 1 month commission.

THE PHOTOS DO NOT CORRESPOND TO THE PREMISES.
IMPORTANT: Please leave us your phone number, name, email address, and availability for viewings. Due to high demand in recent months, this is the fastest way to assign you an advisor specialized in your type of business.
If you need a foreign language translator, we also offer this service in English, French, and Chinese.
We are experts in commercial premises and can help you choose the best location for your business. We have professionals in Marketing, Architecture, Decoration, Management, Renovation, and Licensing.

ATTENTION: The information included regarding this property is not binding and does not form part of any offer or contract and may be subject to any modifications requested by the owners. We also inform you that, in the event that you require verification of documents, licenses, floor plan surveys, or feasibility reports, the expenses for the architect, technician, surveyor, manager, or lawyer will be at the expense and charge of the interested new tenant.
